description: Implementation of the 'closed_rx_window_handler' class managing reception window events, processing uplink and PRACH contexts, and collecting metrics in a wireless communication system.

classes.name: closed_rx_window_handler
classes.description: Handles reception window events, manages context processing, and metrics collection for a specific sector in a wireless system.

methods.name: on_new_symbol
methods.description: Processes a new symbol event, deferring context handling tasks.

methods.name: collect_metrics
methods.description: Collects and resets internal metrics counters.

methods.name: handle_uplink_context
methods.description: Handles uplink context for a given symbol point, notifying and updating metrics.

methods.name: handle_prach_context
methods.description: Handles PRACH context for a given symbol point, notifying and updating metrics.
